definitions.gloss: at once, immediately, right away, promptly
definitions.explanation: Indicates that an action is taken without delay, often in response to something.

examples.japanese: {早速|さっそく}⟦{始|はじ}めましょう→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}って→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧{早速|さっそく}⟦{返事|へんじ}→返事：00844_henji⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I received the email and replied immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦レシピ→レシピ：07157_reshipi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{早速|さっそく}⟦{試|ため}して→試す：02130_tamesu⟧⟦みた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I tried out the new recipe right away.

notes:
{早速|さっそく} conveys acting promptly, often in eager response to new information or an opportunity. It carries a positive nuance of enthusiasm, not just speed.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Typically appears at the beginning of a sentence or directly before the verb.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {早速|さっそく}⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧…: Getting right to the point... (polite transition in business)
- {早速|さっそく}⟦{試|ため}す→試す：02130_tamesu⟧: to try right away
- {早速|さっそく}⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦みる→見る：00283_miru⟧: to try using it right away

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦すぐに→すぐに：02905_suguni⟧: immediately (neutral, no eagerness nuance)
- ⟦{直|ただ}ちに→直ちに：00398_tadachini⟧: immediately (formal, urgent)
- ⟦{即座|そくざ}に→即座：11861_sokuza⟧: instantly (no delay at all)

USAGE:
{早速|さっそく} implies willing, eager action. It would sound odd for reluctant or forced immediate action.
